 Early Black Friday Nintendo deals include saving $30 on the Switch 2 and SanDisk storage upgrades
 This Switch 2 deal might not stick around until after Thanksgiving. 
  By 
 Lauren Allain 
 Lauren Allain 
 Contributor 
 Lauren Allain is a freelance journalist covering deals at Mashable. She graduated from Western Washington University with a B.A. in journalism and holds an M.B.A from Webster Leiden. You can find more of her work online from publications including Reader’s Digest, U.S. News & World Report, Seattle Refined, and more. When she’s not writing, Lauren prefers to be outside hiking, bouldering, swimming, or searching for the perfect location for all three.

 We're still a few weeks away from officially landing on Black Friday , but the deals aren't waiting. That's great news if you're a Nintendo fan or have a gamer on your holiday shopping list. From games to storage upgrades and accessories, we're already seeing sweet deals.
 While we're not seeing deals on the new Zelda Switch 2 or The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 , we do see deals that'll be nice additions to your Zelda gaming sessions.
 SEE ALSO: 
 We found 45 early Black Friday deals already live: Get $200 off MacBooks, 53% off Bose headphones 
 We've compiled the top Nintendo and Nintendo Switch deals that are live ahead of Black Friday. Shopping early means you'll have everything you need for spending the holiday break with Nintendo.

 Why we like it
 While stock is tight on the new Zelda version of the Switch 2, you can snag the standard model already on sale before Black Friday. Head to Woot to get the Nintendo Switch 2 while it's in stock for $469. Amazon Prime members get free shipping with Woot, but keep in mind that Woot deals tend to sell out quickly, so don't wait on this one.

 SanDisk 512GB microSD Express Card
 $159.99 
 at Amazon 
 $199.99 
 Save $40

 Why we like it
 Load up on all the games before winter break thanks to a memory upgrade with the SanDisk 512GB micoSD Express Card . It's designed with write speeds up to 650MB per second and read speeds up to 880MB per second. The SanDisk microSD is officially licensed by Nintendo for the Switch 2, so you'll be good to go for all you gaming needs. Since memory is in short supply and prices continue to rise, snag this deal before it expires.

 Why we like it
 If your Switch 2 will be coming along on winter holiday travel, snag the Belkin Travel Case while it's on sale for $24.99. It offers protection and easy transport for the Switch 2 itself, an AirTag, up to 12 game cards, cables, and a cleaning cloth. While the exterior is tough and durable, the interior is soft and protective.
